name: Immac Realty
organization_description:
REAL ESTATE BROKER FOR NEW YORK CITY!

Immac Realty was founded in 2007 by owner and Principal Broker Cammi J. Marlin and has 16 years experience in the industry.

Prior to starting the firm as Principal Broker, Cammi J. Marlin was a licensed salesperson for 5 years with focus in the rental market while simultaneously employed as a Receptionist for a Mid-Size Real Estate Management company. Working for the management company has given her invaluable first hand insight and perspective on all aspects of the business, and guided mentorship from experienced Landlords & Property Managers.

As a independent broker, Cammi is dedicated to customer attention and service and loves her job. Immac Realty handles 20+  Buildings Exclusively throughout Manhattan.  This large property base has given us extensive knowledge of our product, Landlord/Tenant trust & loyalty, and a large Manhattan based network consisting of Landlords, Brokers, Contractors, Attorneys, Appraisers, Architects, Designers & beloved Clients in every industry New York has to offer.

As a REBNY member we have full access to MLS rental and sales listings throughout all five boroughs. If you are looking for something that is not on this website, we can still help you find your perfect home! Just let us know your requirement and we can get started. You can search our listings at any time on this website as well

If you would like to list a rental or sales property with Immac Realty please rest assured your property will be handled with experience, professionalism and dedication.All properties are aggressively marketed, rental tenants are thoroughly screened, all paperwork and leases are handled in house and organzied for your review. For Sales, we will ensure your property is competive based on recent comparable sales, and ensure potential future buyers are qualified and will pass your Coop Board. We know the market, walk the neighborhoods and will bring you the best offers available from qualified tenants.  Feel free to relax while we handle it all!

We strive to meet the needs of all parties to ensure a good match and lasting relationship between all. We are always accessible to provide the best service possible. We are experienced in working closely with management companies and landlords to ensure a smooth transition from customer to tenant.

If you are making the decision to purchase or sell an apartment, we can walk you through the process and will focus on your requirements & wish lists that fit within your budget and time frame. We have the experience, market knowledge, and expertise on the sales process to make the journey not only an exciting one, but one that will be rewarding, profitable, and tailored to suit you. 
Anything that can be done to make the moving process, landlord/tenant relationship, and your real estate investment a great experience is our focus & goal!
